contact_sources.quote: Home / People / Julian Sinclair Supervisory Board Member Julian Sinclair Member of the Management Committee Julian sits on the Supervisory Board, advising the Senior Partner and partnership with a particular emphasis on the investment process and philosophy. Julian served as Chief Investment Officer of Macdoch Asset Management Ltd. Previously he was Chief Investment Officer of Talisman Global Asset Management, as well as a founding shareholder at Adjuvo, a UHNWI syndicate. He was an Ira Sohn invited 'stock pitcher' in 2013 and was senior non-executive director of Aberdeen Diversified Income & Growth Trust plc, Standard Life Aberdeen’s flagship multi asset investment until retiring from the board in June 2021.

Julian Sinclair - Chief Investment Officer & Non Exec Director
## Experience
- Supervisory Board at Hosking Partners LLP (Dec 2021 to present)
- Independent Adviser - Global UHNWI families and family offices at Self Employed / Independent (Jan 2025 to present)
- Investment Committee Member at Barts Charity (Jul 2025 to present)
- Chief Investment Officer at Macdoch (Feb 2020 to Sep 2024)
- Non Executive Director at Aberdeen Diversified Income and Growth Trust plc (Jul 2015 to Jun 2021) [...] # Julian Sinclair
